## 2026-09-22 — Q7.1: Standards panel, drafted proactively (first pass of a domain built fresh)

**Bucket:** [Standard]/AI-draftable — same treatment Infrastructure's and
Networking's proactive panels received, since this domain has no migrated
terms to reconcile against.

**Answer:** NIST SP 800-218 (SSDF) and NIST SP 800-53 CM family as the
formal standards grounding CI/CD security gates and change/configuration
management. ITIL cited distinctly in authority (practitioner framework,
not ISO/NIST) for Operational SOPs vocabulary. Conventional Commits, DORA
metrics, GitOps principles, and Keep a Changelog flagged as
community-originated. SLSA flagged as a candidate not yet adopted — a
genuine scope decision, not assumed for a generalized framework.

**Status:** Pending explicit review.
